| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Require cam/VVT sync for ignition | `isPhaseSyncRequiredForIgnition` | choice |  | Some engines are OK running semi-random sequential while other engine require phase synchronization |
| Cam sync crank revolution | `camSyncOnSecondCrankRevolution` | choice |  | When we sync cam sensor is that first or second full engine revolution of the four stroke cycle? |
| Maximum cam/VVT sync RPM | `maxCamPhaseResolveRpm` | rpm | 0 … 12500 | Below this RPM, use camshaft information to synchronize the crank's position for full sequential operation. Use this if your cam sensor does weird things at high RPM. Set to 0 to disable, and always use cam to help sync crank. |
| MAP readout angle | `mapCamDetectionAnglePosition` | Deg | 0 … 360 | Magic engine phase: we compare instant MAP at X to instant MAP at x+360 angle in one complete cycle |
| MAP delta threshold | `mapSyncThreshold` | {bitStringValue(pressureUnitsLabels | 0 … {useMetricOnInterface ? 0 : 0} | Delta kPa/psi for MAP sync |
| Enable noise filtering | `useNoiselessTriggerDecoder` | choice |  |  |
| Print verbose VVT sync details to console | `verboseVVTDecoding` | choice |  | Verbose info in console below engineSnifferRpmThreshold |
| Print verbose trigger sync to console | `verboseTriggerSynchDetails` | choice |  | Verbose info in console below engineSnifferRpmThreshold |
| Display logic signals | `displayLogicLevelsInEngineSniffer` | choice |  | Shall we display real life signal or just the part consumed by trigger decoder. Applies to both trigger and cam/vvt input. |
| Do not print messages in case of sync error | `silentTriggerError` | choice |  | Sometimes we have a performance issue while printing error |
| Focus on inputs in engine sniffer | `engineSnifferFocusOnInputs` | choice |  | In this mode only trigger events go into engine sniffer and not coils/injectors etc |
